name: Holy Cross Health volunteer program (high school students)
org: Holy Cross Health (Silver Spring and Germantown hospitals)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a Holy Cross hospital or health center in a clinical, customer service, administrative or support role. Year-round and summer-only openings are listed.
who_can_apply: Minimum age is 16. High school students use a separate application and must attend an in-person orientation. Needs a health screening (MMR, varicella, flu, TB testing) and availability to start within one month of applying.
duration: Not stated on the main page
deadline_text: High school applications for summer 2026 are closed. Summer 2027 applications open Jan 4, 2027 at 3:30 p.m. Sign up closes when spots fill.
how_to_apply: When it opens, use the high school summer application on the Holy Cross volunteer applications page. Sign up for an info session too. Then complete a screening interview and orientation. Current juniors can ask their school's Internship Coordinator about a senior year internship.
notes: Another site named holy-cross.com is Holy Cross in Fort Lauderdale, Florida; use holycrosshealth.org for Maryland. Background checks are required for volunteers 18 and older. Unpaid volunteering, so no work permit.
